description: Upload a small file (max ~90 KiB over MCP; Pro account required) and get an attachment id to include in broadcast or ask_question via attachment_ids. Larger files: use the PingRoom CLI or agent REST API.

content_base64.description: Base64-encoded file bytes (standard alphabet, padding optional).

filename.description: File name including extension, e.g. report.md.

mime_type.description: Optional MIME type, e.g. text/markdown. Defaults from the filename extension.

name: upload_attachment

result.description: Purpose-built PingRoom result with credential and account fields removed.

title: Upload Attachment
